name: barbell clean high pull
description: A powerful pull from the floor that sends the bar to chest height. It develops explosive hips, traps and shoulders.
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and a flat back.
Lift the bar to your knees with your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height with elbows high and outside.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.
